headline: Saurav Das To File Legal Complaints Following Passport Data Leak
metaDescription: Saurav Das of CJP plans to file criminal complaints after his passport details were leaked online following a travel incident at an airport.
aiSummaryBullets: Saurav Das, co-convenor of Citizens for Justice and Peace, intends to file criminal complaints regarding a recent data breach.
The incident occurred after his passport details were shared online following his inability to board a flight to London.
Passport authorities in Chennai had previously identified discrepancies regarding his travel documentation.
aiContextParagraph: Saurav Das, a co-convenor for the non-profit organization Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), has announced plans to initiate criminal proceedings against several social media accounts. This decision follows the unauthorized circulation of his personal passport information online. The leak occurred shortly after Das was prevented from boarding a London-bound flight, a situation prompted by discrepancies flagged by the Chennai passport office. Das has publicly characterized the sharing of his identification details as a campaign of targeted harassment against him. This development highlights ongoing concerns regarding digital privacy and the misuse of social media platforms for disseminating sensitive personal data. Authorities have not provided further details on the specific handles involved or the progress of the passport investigation, but the incident has drawn significant public attention due to the high-profile nature of the victim and the nature of the data involved.
whyItIsViral: This story has gained strong search interest as users track developments regarding the public disclosure of personal documentation belonging to Saurav Das.
